description: Use this when the user asks what to buy for a deck (id or name), or for all decks (omit deck), and a table helps: missing cards with count, cheapest non-foil printing and unit price, a total in `currency` (default USD) and the plain "4 Card Name" list. Reads the same data as generate_buylist and changes nothing; run claim_from_collection first or owned copies still count as coverable. Give `unpriced_items` with the total, and relay `rate_missing` when present: it means no CHF price could be given at all.

currency.description: Display currency. USD/EUR come from Scryfall; CHF is always EUR × the stored ECB rate. A response that carries `rate_missing` could not price in CHF at all: tell the user that, not that the cards have no price.

deck.description: Deck id or name; omit for all decks combined

name: show_buylist

image_uri.description: The card's picture on Scryfall, to show as it is; null when the catalogue has none

scryfall_url.description: The card's page on Scryfall: link the card's name to it

unit_price.description: The cheapest priced non-foil printing; null: no price yet, left out of the total

rate_missing.description: Present when CHF was asked and no CHF rate is stored: no CHF price could be given at all, the cards are not unpriced. Relay it.

total_estimated.description: Leaves out unpriced_items: give that count with the total

title: Show what to buy
